messages:
monica: Quick heads-up — we're ready to start the v1 -> v2 deprecation comms next week. main asks: (1) docs migration guide, (2) snippet updates for SDK breaking rename (client.call -> client.invoke), (3) embedding model swap + alias fallback note. Who can own which?
jared: I can take the SDK snippets. timeline? do we have a target date for the public deprecation banner?
monica: target banner + emails on 2026-04-07. want docs and redirects live a day earlier. so snippets by EOD 2026-04-05 ideally.
priya: PR draft ready for the migration guide: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3872 — it outlines a step-by-step migration and checklist. needs sample code fixes and a short FAQ section.
emily: I can do redirects and the deprecation banner copy. I'll need the canonical alias map for embeddings and model swap notes.
sean: one note: streaming framing changed between v1/v2, so any chat examples that use streaming need updated event parsing. I have a stress-test snippet that shows the new framing.
docs-bot: Build queued for branch docs/migration-3872. Status: queued → in_progress.
monica: Action list:
 - jared: update all JS/TS snippets in the guide and top-level quickstarts (client.call -> client.invoke)
 - priya: land migration guide PR, add FAQ about rollback and compatibility
 - emily: add 301 redirects for old docs pages and add banner content
 - sean: provide streaming example + test harness
Also need a short blurb for support to reference when customers ask about embed model alias fallback.
jared: quick question on code examples — do we want to show both old and new API surfaces or only new? showing both might be noisy.
priya: show both with a clear "Before"/"After" block and emphasize that old v1 responses will continue for X weeks with the shim, but not for long.
emily: I'll own redirect list. send me all old paths. also plan to add a `docs-deprecation` tag so search results surface the migration guide.
sean: snippet for streaming framing (paste):
```
// v1 streaming (old framing)
for await (const chunk of client.stream("v1-chat", prompt)) {
  // chunk.data
}

// v2 streaming (new framing)
for await (const event of client.streamEvents({model: "v2-chat", prompt})) {
  if (event.type === "delta") console.log(event.delta);
}
```
monica: perfect, include that in PR 3872 or a follow-up PR and link them. jared — here's an example patch for the simple sync change you can copy into the quickstarts:
```
// BEFORE
const res = await client.call({ model: "redwood/v1-chat", input: "Hello" });

// AFTER
const res = await client.invoke({ model: "redwood/v2-chat", prompt: "Hello" });
```
jared: thanks, I'll apply across code-samples, npm package examples, and the TypeScript snippets. will open a PR per folder and link to the migration guide.
priya: regarding embeddings: model "embed-1" -> new recommended "embed-lite-v2". we should add a small note about cosine similarity equivalence and an alias fallback that maps "embed-1" → "embed-lite-v2" for 30 days. I'll add that to FAQ.
emily: for support blurb: "We will map requests to `embed-1` to `embed-lite-v2` for 30 days after the banner. Please migrate to `embed-lite-v2` for best latency and tokenization parity." OK?
sean: can we also add a code snippet for embeddings change (python example)?
monica: yes, include both JS and Python. sample JS embedding migration:
```
// BEFORE
const e = await client.embed({ model: "embed-1", text: "..." });

// AFTER
const e = await client.embed({ model: "embed-lite-v2", input: "..." });
```
emily: PRs I'll watch/merge: docs/pull/3872 (migration guide), docs/pull/3890 (redirects/banner). please tag me in PRs and put a short changelog in the PR body.
jared: I'll open PRs: docs/pull/3881 (js snippets), docs/pull/3882 (ts quickstarts), docs/pull/3883 (npm examples). I'll link them in 3872's checklist.
priya: small nit — update the migration guide to call out rollout policy: recommend canary traffic to v2 models for 24h before full swap and keep KV cache warmers in place.
monica: good call. add that under "Deployment checklist".
emily: I've drafted banner text (short): "Deprecation notice: v1 API will be retired on 2026-05-07. See migration guide (link)." will iterate copy after PRs land.
docs-bot: docs build succeeded for branch docs/migration-3872 at 2481240300.
monica: final ask — once PRs are merged, please ping #announcements and #support with the timeline + support blurb. emily, can you post the banner + redirect live on 2026-04-06?
emily: yes, schedule set for 2026-04-06 09:00 PT. I'll post in channels and add the support blurb to the internal playbook.
sean: I'll run the snippet tests against staging v2 tonight and report back with any failures.
jared: noted. I'll include a deprecation note in the SDK CHANGELOG too.
monica: awesome — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a one-pager for execs and the comms calendar after lunch. :thumbsup:
